shortDescription: Manage an SSL Orchestrator SWG service

options.name: access_profile
options.description: Specifies a custom SWG-Transparent access profile to apply to the SWG service. During creation of a new SWG service, when the parameter is not specified, the configuration auto generates the access profile.

options.name: dump_json
options.description: Sets the module to output a JSON blob for further consumption. When C(true) does not make any changes on the device and always returns C(changed=False). The output provided is idempotent in nature, meaning if there are no changes to be made during C(MODIFY) on an existing service, no JSON output is generated.

options.name: log_settings
options.description: Specifies a custom log setting for the SWG service.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the SWG service object. The configuration auto-prepends C(ssloS_) to the object. Names should be less than 14 characters and not contain dashes C(-).

options.name: named_scope
options.description: Required when C(profile_scope) is C(named), and specifies a name string the authentication and SWG policies share to allow access to identity information. This parameter is ignored when C(profile_scope) is C(profile).

options.name: profile_scope
options.description: Specifies the level of information sharing. When using named scope, an authentication access profile attached to the topology can share its user identity information with the SWG policy.

options.name: rules
options.description: Specifies custom iRules to apply to the SWG service.

options.name: service_down_action
options.description: Specifies the action taken if the SWG service fails.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(state) is C(present), ensures the object is created or modified. When C(state) is C(absent), ensures the service is removed.

options.name: swg_policy
options.description: Specifies the name of the SWG per-request policy to attach to the service configuration. This parameter is required when creating a new service.

options.name: swg_policy_type
options.description: The custom type of per-request policy attached to the SWG service configuration.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time to wait for the C(CREATE), C(MODIFY) or C(DELETE) task to complete, in seconds. The accepted value range is between C(10) and C(1800) seconds.
